Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the independence date to 7 June 1929 (the ratification/entry-into-force date) instead of 11 February 1929 (the signing/creation date of the Vatican City State via the Lateran Treaty). This misinterpreted “became its own country” and led away from the correct answer of 11 February 1929 despite earlier correct findings and sources.
